Guide.overview:
Sample data.

This baseline stops the common mail-borne attacks in two stages. The first stage is safe for every tenant. The second stage can break older devices that send mail, so it needs preparation.

**Before you start**

- List the printers, scanners and applications that send mail through Exchange Online.
- Ask the client which mailboxes forward mail to an outside address on purpose.

stages.name: Baseline
stages.guide:
Sample data.

Automatic forwarding to outside addresses is blocked, mailbox auditing is turned on and outside senders that use an internal display name get a warning.

Agree on the forwarding exceptions before remediation is turned on.

communications.title: Announcement of the forwarding block
communications.body:
Hi,

We are going to block automatic forwarding of mail to addresses outside your organisation. This is a common way for attackers to read mail unnoticed.

If a mailbox has to keep forwarding, reply with the mailbox and the address it forwards to and we will make an exception.

stages.name: Hardening
stages.guide:
Sample data.

Basic authentication for SMTP is turned off and personal safe sender lists are no longer honoured.

Move every device from your list to a supported way of sending mail first. Plan this stage at least two weeks after the first one.

communications.title: Notice about devices that send mail
communications.body:
Hi,

On the agreed date we turn off the old sign-in method that some printers and scanners use to send mail. We have updated the devices we know about.

If scan to email stops working on a device after that date, let us know which one and we will fix it.

communications.title: Notice to staff about safe senders
communications.body: Your personal safe senders list in Outlook no longer bypasses the spam filter. If mail from a sender you trust ends up in quarantine, release it from the quarantine message or ask us to allow the sender.

Baseline.description: Sample data. Exchange Online settings that stop the common mail-borne attacks, in two stages. Everything is report only.
